description: The autonomy.used event (S56 T6, R5): published by the loop's decision site AFTER a completed/failed use row is recorded — the event is the signal of a row that exists, so a failed write publishes nothing (an event for a row that is not there is a second truth). The payload names the loop, the grant it ran under, the action, the phase and the begun row it closes: ids and enums only. It is filed under the loop's OWN project root (S31 D1), so a subscriber filtered by Filter{ComponentRoot} gets one project's uses and not the machine's. No notify hint (R5).
